_comment: Ground truth read by hand from the five customer quotes. totalCost = grand total payable as stated on the quote. orderLines exclude alternatives ('Alt.' / 'Alternative to the preceding item') and carried-forward subtotals.

orderLines.positionDescription: Moss Art Panel, Mixed Moss 63 x 31.5 in

traps: item 5 is an alternative (vertical logo) and must not be a line
item 2 has a -20% discount so qty x unit != total
bank details and EIN appear in the footer on both pages

fractional quantities in sq ft and lin ft

'Carried forward $1,560.00' is a page subtotal, not a line
EIN is printed as '94 1985704' with a space

orderLines.positionDescription: 13" MacBook Air: Apple M2 Chip - Space Gray
